snippet.title: Why Bonnie Wright’s Acting Looked So Strange on the Harry Potter Set #bonniewright #harrypotter
snippet.description: Why did Bonnie Wright’s acting as Ginny Weasley sometimes look awkward in Harry Potter? Bonnie admitted she often felt uncomfortable on set, especially during emotional scenes. Even her hug with Harry during Dumbledore’s farewell looked so stiff the crew had to guide her through it — and the kiss scene was filmed on day one of Half-Blood Prince, making it even more nerve-racking. Still, she delivered some great moments, like the “Shut it” line that was perfect on the very first take.
